## Practice Warm-up Test

This is a practice test and does not count towards your grade.

Enter your **Neptun code** and start the test. Your seminar group and task will be assigned automatically.

```{=html}
<div id="warmup-app">
  <label for="neptun"><strong>Neptun code</strong></label>
  <input id="neptun" maxlength="6" autocomplete="off">
  <button id="start-warmup">Start Warm-up Test</button>
  <p id="warmup-message"></p>
</div>
```

> This prototype frontend is prepared for the backend architecture. Set `API_BASE`
> after the Azure Function has been deployed. The roster and task pools must never
> be copied into this QMD or the public GitHub repository.

<script>
const API_BASE = ""; // e.g. Azure Function endpoint, configured after deployment

document.getElementById("start-warmup").addEventListener("click", async () => {
  const n = document.getElementById("neptun").value.trim().toUpperCase();
  const msg = document.getElementById("warmup-message");
  if (!/^[A-Z0-9]{6}$/.test(n)) {
    msg.textContent = "Please enter a valid 6-character Neptun code.";
    return;
  }
  if (!API_BASE) {
    msg.textContent = "Prototype ready: backend endpoint has not been configured yet.";
    return;
  }
  // Production call: POST only the Neptun code to /start.
  // The backend returns only the student's assigned group/task/deadline.
});
</script>
